executionNotes: Initial pnpm check hit sandbox spawnSync git EPERM; unchanged native rerun passes. Both logs retained.
First executable build stopped at the 1 GiB sampled RSS budget; rerun passed with a build-only 2 GiB budget and the same 3 GiB host reserve. No product assertion or crypto parameter changed.
All verification jobs sequential; Node heap 256 MiB.

An initial report-only path filter mistook export-prefixed source filenames for generated output folders. The corrected folder-only filter found no unwanted output. This was a report-harness error, not a product failure.
